`research-ingest` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Turns a supplied article, paper, PDF, podcast, video, media link, or local source into durable extracted research that can be discussed, compared, and reused later.

## When to use it

use this skill when ko sends a youtube, podcast, article, paper, pdf, media link, or local source and wants to learn from it, discuss it, turn it into notes, compare it with other sources, or save it as durable research. this skill governs the research ingest workflow: run the workspace research ingest tool, create packet/extracted/manifest artifacts, automatically save their full text to memory, then reason from the saved bundle. use for research packets, source ingestion, podcast/video learning, durable memory, and follow-up analysis from ingested sources..

Typical requests include:

- “Ingest this paper and turn it into durable notes.”
- “Learn from this podcast and compare it with our existing research.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill research-ingest
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill research-ingest
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/research-ingest/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Use it when the source itself should become durable research context. Ordinary web discovery does not require a research-ingest packet.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/research-ingest/SKILL.md` exists and that `research-ingest` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `research-ingest` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
